about.map.title: What the map shows
about.map: Each person is described by the keywords found in their texts, weighted by how much they use them. The map places people and keywords so that those who share vocabulary end up close together.
about.distances.title: What distances mean
about.distances: Two nearby points use similar words. The drawing squeezes many dimensions into two, so a short distance is meaningful, but a long one is only a rough indication, and the directions (up, left) mean nothing.
about.distances.page: The Distances page measures them without the drawing: in the space of the themes the map is drawn from, or by the themes people share. It ranks everyone by how alike they are to a person or an organisation, lists who talks the same without working together (and the reverse), and draws matrices; each list can be saved as CSV.
about.themes.title: Themes
about.themes: The keywords are grouped into themes, which may have sub-themes. A person's share of a theme is the part of their vocabulary's use that falls in it; colours follow the top-level theme.

person.coauthors.note: The people of this site who signed texts with this person, the most texts together first.
about.coauthors.title: Who writes with whom
about.coauthors: Two people write together when they signed the same text; the atlas draws these links around the person or the organisation in focus, up to three circles away. Similarity, measured on the words, is shown only when two are compared.
